title: The hardest pill to swallow? Realizing some people were only in your life because of the role you played in theirs. 🎭
paragraphs: The hardest pill to swallow? Realizing some people were only in your life because of the role you played in theirs. 🎭

When God gets ready to elevate you to a new level of spiritual warfare, He has to clear the stage. The masks have to fall off. Don’t mourn the exit of people who couldn't handle your truth. They didn't leave you; they were removed for your protection.
As a Gospel Warrior, you need soldiers beside you, not actors.

📜 Bible Verse: "They went out from us, but they did not really belong to us. For if they had belonged to us, they would have remained with us; but their going showed that none of them belonged to us." - 1 John 2:19 (NIV)
👇 Drop an "AMEN" if you are done with fake energy!
